title: Study and Research Opportunities Abroad with Erasmus+
bodyHtml:
As the Faculty of Computer and Information Technologies, we currently have Erasmus+ agreements with 7 universities across Europe. These partnerships provide our students with the opportunity to study abroad, experience different cultures, and engage with international academic communities.
Our partner universities and their countries are listed below:

  • TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY OF VARNA (Bulgaria)

  • UNIVERSITAET OSNABRUECK (Germany)

  • VILNIAUS UNIVERSITETAS (Lithuania)

  • VILNIAUS GEDIMINO TECHNIKOS UNIVERSITETAS (Lithuania)

  • UNIVERSITATEA 1 DECEMBRIE 1918 (Romania)

  • POZNAN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY (Poland)

For more detailed information, please visit this link.

title: Announcement for the 2024-2025 Academic Year Specialized Programs
bodyHtml:
Istanbul University, in collaboration with the Ministry of Industry and Technology as part of the National Technology Initiative, is launching Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Driving Technologies, and Chip Design Specialization Programs for the 2024-2025 academic year. These programs aim to provide high-quality education in three key focus areas to nurture the skilled workforce needed for our country.

Program Overview

These specialization programs are designed for 3rd and 4th-year students of relevant university departments. The program will begin with a 5-week foundational course, followed by 25 to 30 weeks of specialized training. Throughout the program, students will work on project-based learning and receive mentorship from expert firms.     Eligible Departments: Computer Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Artificial Intelligence Engineering, Software Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, etc.

  2. Autonomous Driving Technologies Specialization Program:
    Partners: Aselsan, AVL, Baykar, Fev Turkey, Ford, Togg, TÜBİTAK
    Training: Autonomous Systems Development Specialization
    Eligible Departments: Computer Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Automotive Engineering, etc.

  3. Chip Design Specialization Program:
    Partners: Ankasys, Electra IC, Elevation, TÜTEL, Yongatek
    Training: Digital Design and Verification Specialization
    Eligible Departments: Electrical-Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, etc.

  • Mentorship Support: Each student will receive personalized support from expert mentors throughout the program.
  • Project-Based Education: Students will work on mid-term and final projects throughout their training.
  • Internship Opportunities: Successful graduates of the program will be provided with internship opportunities at partner companies.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • 3rd or 4th-year undergraduate student
  • A minimum GPA of 2.80
  • Applicants can only apply to one specialization program.

Application Dates:

Applications opened on August 26, 2024, and will close on September 16, 2024. The application process will be carried out through the official program website.

More Information and Application:

For detailed information and to apply, please visit milliteknolojiakademisi.gov.tr.

We encourage all eligible students to take advantage of this unique opportunity by completing their applications on time.

title: 4th Patentle Türkiye Universities Patent Competition
bodyHtml:
The 4th Patentle Türkiye Universities Patent Competition is being organised to raise university students’ awareness of patents, one of the most important tools of technological development, and to help students gain knowledge and experience in patent searches and patent applications.

Patent applications within the scope of the competition will be accepted between 1 May and 15 December 2024 through the Electronic Application System (EPATS) of the Turkish Patent and Trademark Office.

At the award ceremony, a total of 850,000 TL in prizes will be given: 100,000 TL to the first place, 80,000 TL to the second, 60,000 TL to the third, 50,000 TL each to the fourth, fifth and sixth, 40,000 TL each to the seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth, and 30,000 TL each to the remaining 10 students in the top 20.
